title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 6
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q051_let_up
elements.title: The rain finally began to ___, so we were able to take down our umbrellas.

elements.name: q052_a_new_low
elements.title: Attendance hit ___ this winter, with fewer visitors than in any previous season.

elements.name: q053_overtake
elements.title: The cyclist accelerated to ___ the rider in front and take the lead.

elements.name: q054_unsettled
elements.title: Plans remain ___: nobody knows whether the move will happen this month or next.

elements.name: q055_key
elements.title: Reliable transport was a ___ factor in choosing the venue: we ruled out every site that guests couldn't reach by bus or train.

elements.name: q056_associated
elements.title: The smell of fresh bread is closely ___ with memories of my grandmother's house.

elements.name: q057_preserve
elements.title: The archive uses temperature-controlled storage to ___ old photographs in their original condition.

elements.name: q058_star_studded
elements.title: The awards show was ___, with famous performers in nearly every row.

elements.name: q059_pinch_me_moment
elements.title: Winning an award from her favourite writer felt like a ___: she could hardly believe it was real.

elements.name: q060_fill_the_gap
elements.title: With the main bridge closed, a temporary ferry was brought in to ___.
